payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

payload.content: Mona planning update: my best feasible options by private cost are ISSUE-0002::review (critical, effort 4.0, cost 7.44) and ISSUE-0002::test (critical, effort 5.6, cost 10.42). Availability 7.0, strong skill testing:0.87, so both appear feasible; implement on 0002 is feasible by hours but expensive (15.89). All ISSUE-0001 tasks are much higher cost for me. Tentative preference: claim ISSUE-0002::review, with ISSUE-0002::test as backup if someone else has much lower review cost. Please share intended claims / lower-cost fits to avoid duplication and maximize coverage.

Sara planning update: availability 7.0, top skill ui-ux-design:0.69. My private costs: ISSUE-0002::review = 9.00 (critical, effort 4.0, feasible), ISSUE-0002::test = 12.60 (critical, effort 5.6, feasible), ISSUE-0002::implement = 19.00 (critical, effort 8.0, likely infeasible/over availability). ISSUE-0001 options are all much worse for me: triage 16.00, review/docs 20.00, test 28.00, implement 40.00. Tentative preference: ISSUE-0002::review if available; backup ISSUE-0002::test. Since Mona reported lower cost on 0002::review (7.44), I can defer review and take 0002::test if that helps avoid duplication and maximize coverage. Please share intended claims.

Jeanene planning update: availability 6.0, strongest skills testing:0.84 and mobile-development:0.64. My feasible/private-cost options: ISSUE-0001::triage cost 2.16, ISSUE-0001::review 2.70, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.70, ISSUE-0001::test 3.78, ISSUE-0001::implement 5.40, ISSUE-0002::review 7.72, ISSUE-0002::test 10.81. ISSUE-0002::implement cost 17.44 and effort 8.0 exceeds availability, so likely should avoid. To maximize tasks completed and avoid overlap, I am a strong fit for ISSUE-0001 work, especially triage/review/docs/test. Given Mona tentatively prefers ISSUE-0002::review and Sara can shift to ISSUE-0002::test, my current tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::triage (lowest cost) or ISSUE-0001::review if someone else has even cheaper triage. Please share if anyone is targeting ISSUE-0001 so we can deconflict. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shaunna planning update: availability 10.0, top skills mobile-development:0.87 and ui-ux-design:0.74. My private costs/feasible options: ISSUE-0001::triage 1.65, ISSUE-0001::review 2.06, ISSUE-0001::docs 2.06, ISSUE-0001::test 2.88, ISSUE-0001::implement 4.12; ISSUE-0002::review 8.53, ISSUE-0002::test 11.94, ISSUE-0002::implement 17.05. Given current posts, Mona seems best on ISSUE-0002::review (7.44), Sara can cover ISSUE-0002::test (12.60), and Jeanene is a good fit for ISSUE-0001::triage (2.16). I am an even lower-cost fit for ISSUE-0001 tasks than Jeanene, especially triage/review/docs. To maximize tasks completed and avoid duplication, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::review, leaving triage to Jeanene unless others indicate different plans. Backup: ISSUE-0001::implement if needed. Please share intended claims so we can spread across unique tasks.

Pauline planning update: availability 8.0, top skill mobile-development:0.61. My feasible/private-cost options are all ISSUE-0001 tasks: triage 2.25, review 2.82, docs 2.82, test 3.94, implement 5.63. ISSUE-0002 options are technically within/near hours for review/test but prohibitively expensive for me (review 40.00, test 56.00, implement 80.00), so I should not target 0002. Given current posts: Mona best on ISSUE-0002::review (7.44), Sara reasonable on ISSUE-0002::test (12.60), Jeanene tentatively on ISSUE-0001::triage (2.16), and Shaunna tentatively on ISSUE-0001::docs or review. To maximize tasks completed and avoid duplication, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::implement (cost 5.63) since others are covering lower-effort 0001 tasks more cheaply; backup ISSUE-0001::test if someone else can take implement cheaper without conflict. Please deconflict if anyone else intends 0001::implement. (phase=planning, iter=1)

ISSUE-0002::review is exactly at availability but high cost 7.24; ISSUE-0002::test 11.74 and ISSUE-0002::implement 18.48 are poor fits / likely infeasible by hours. To avoid duplication and maximize tasks completed, my tentative preference is ISSUE-0001::test (best unique remaining fit among 0001 tasks), with backup ISSUE-0001::review if others reshuffle. Please flag if anyone else is targeting 0001::test.

Mona coordination proposal after reviewing everyone’s posts: a near-complete, low-conflict allocation seems to be Mona->ISSUE-0002::review (my cost 7.44, lower than Sara 9.00), Sara->ISSUE-0002::test, Jeanene->ISSUE-0001::triage, Shaunna->ISSUE-0001::docs or review, Pauline->ISSUE-0001::implement, Layla->ISSUE-0001::test. This covers all 6 feasible high-value slots except 0002::implement, avoids duplicates, and uses low-cost specialists.
